name: Enishi Kazusa
source: [url=/c37952]Kaoru's[/url] classmate and the class president of his class who is a very stubborn but strict girl. She always puts rules first before anything, but this is because she grew up in a very strict household. Believing she can't leave the unreliable Kaoru alone, she often lectures him. Because of her strong personality, she is quite weak when it comes to sex and other perverted topics.
